explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1105: for every k ≥ 3, AR(n,C_k) - ((k-2)/2 + 1/(k-1))n = O(1). antiRamseyNum is the maximum number of colours in a surjective edge colouring of K_n with no rainbow copy, which is the page's convention. As a sanity check, k = 3 gives n + O(1), consistent with AR(n,C_3) = n - 1.
